scripts.dev: pnpm i18n:generate && pnpm client:build && pnpm --parallel --filter gooseforum-resource --filter @gooseforum/web --filter @gooseforum/client run dev:watch
scripts.build:react: pnpm i18n:generate && pnpm client:build && pnpm --filter @gooseforum/web build
scripts.typecheck:react: pnpm i18n:generate && pnpm client:build && pnpm --filter @gooseforum/i18n --filter @gooseforum/markdown --filter @gooseforum/runtime --filter @gooseforum/ui --filter @gooseforum/theme-default --filter @gooseforum/web run typecheck
scripts.lint:react: eslint apps/web/src packages/i18n/src packages/markdown/src packages/runtime/src packages/ui/src packages/theme-default/src packages/theme-default/test --max-warnings 171 --format ./scripts/eslint-summary-formatter.mjs
scripts.test:react: pnpm i18n:generate && pnpm --filter @gooseforum/theme-default test && pnpm --filter @gooseforum/web test && pnpm test:react-dom-scanner && pnpm test:tailwind-audit
scripts.check:react:dead-code: pnpm i18n:generate && knip --workspace apps/web --workspace packages/markdown --workspace packages/runtime --workspace packages/ui --workspace packages/theme-default --include files,dependencies,unlisted,binaries
scripts.check:react: pnpm check:docs && pnpm check:boundaries && pnpm check:i18n && pnpm typecheck:react && pnpm lint:react && pnpm test:react && pnpm scan:react-dom && pnpm check:react:dead-code && pnpm build:react && pnpm check:react:bundle
scripts.check:react:full: pnpm check:react && pnpm test:react:coverage && pnpm test:react:e2e
scripts.test: pnpm client:build && pnpm client:test && pnpm test:react
